name: PhillyTrains
author: trevorsscott
description:
Ready to move closer to your world, my friends?

This jawn replaces the base game trains with those unique to the rails of the lower Delaware & Schuylkill Valleys:
Heavy rail => Kawasaki B-IV
Light metro => ASEA Type N-5
Light rail => Citadis Spirit
Tram => Kawasaki LRV
Commuter rail => Silverliner V
Diesel commuter rail => GP40PH-2B with Comet V Cars

Plus ADtranz M4s, PATCO I & IIs, GTW 2/6s, ACS-64s with both SEPTA coaches & Amfleet I cars

Hat tip on how to mod trains to [DanielD1909](https://subwaybuildermodded.com/registry/authors/DanielD1909) & [NoahGarrf](https://subwaybuildermodded.com/registry/authors/NoahGarrf)!
